# pleatkit

> pleatkit lets users of a React + Vite app change its interface by asking an in-app agent. The agent rewrites only the files you mark as dynamic; each change is compiled on the agent server (or in the browser with esbuild-wasm), signed, loaded from the app's own origin, swapped in without a reload, and saved as that user's own version with undo, history and admin rollback. MIT, bring your own model key (the key stays on your agent server).

Version 0.1.0 (2026-10-18). Not on npm yet: install from a local checkout with `link:` (see install). Supported: Vite 6 to 8, React 18 or 19, TypeScript 5, optional Tailwind 4. Not supported: Next.js, webpack.

## For coding agents installing pleatkit

- [AGENTS.md](docs/for-agents/AGENTS.md): what pleatkit is, zones, invariants, the order of work
- [install.md](docs/for-agents/install.md): steps 0 to 7, each with command, expected output, and what to do if it differs
- [verify.md](docs/for-agents/verify.md): acceptance checks (`pleatkit doctor`, `pleatkit ping`, an edit in the browser, no key in the bundle)
- [troubleshooting.md](docs/for-agents/troubleshooting.md): symptom, cause, command
- [examples/t1-vite](examples/t1-vite): a fresh `create vite` app with pleatkit installed by following the docs; `pnpm smoke` checks it end to end

## Reference

- [README.md](README.md): packages, running the demo, environment variables, CSP, security model
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): design (in Russian)
- [docs/DEVLOG.md](docs/DEVLOG.md): what was built, measurements, open questions (in Russian)
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): changes per version, breaking changes marked
- [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md): npm trusted publishing with provenance (prepared, not used yet)

## Packages

- `@pleatkit/vite-plugin`: zones, manifest, externals registry, fallback bundle, runtime Tailwind module
- `@pleatkit/runtime`: `PleatkitProvider`, `<Dynamic id>`, snapshots, compiler, `LocalStore`, `HttpStore`
- `@pleatkit/ui`: `PleatkitChat` (chat drawer, screenshots, clarifying question, undo, history)
- `@pleatkit/agent`: agent server (`pleatkit-agent`), providers anthropic / openai-compatible / scripted
- `@pleatkit/cli`: `pleatkit doctor`, `pleatkit ping`, `pleatkit keys`, `pleatkit export`
